text: Writing a resume shouldn't take all day.
Resume Builder puts the form on one side, and a live A4 preview on the other. Type, and the page updates instantly.
Built-in coaching flags weak bullet points, accomplishments without numbers, and invalid contact details.
Download an A T S ready PDF. Every word is real, selectable text.
Already have a resume? Import the PDF, and the fields fill themselves in.
Need a cover letter? A second tab builds a clean, one page business letter.
